method: Direct inspection of unmodified raw-runtime frame extractions, supported by full video decode and ordinary-input native route measurements; no generated/render-only substitute.
observed_improvements: Fitted deck panels, traction ribs, bright lateral edge strips and real ground-bearing columns/braces are visible during ramp ascent.
Compact top-left objective and bottom-right health/ammo leave the player, feet and approaching floor visible; text is readable in the inspected 720p frames.
Hall threshold, service-panel exit and four-metre-wide ramp remain accessible with the actual production player camera.

major_defects.observed: Large empty road and plain surrounding ground separate the terrace from isolated repeated tower masses. Approach/return orientation has little authored foreground or midground support.
Fitted geometric panel detail is present, but broad painted/deck/ground surfaces read flat and uniform at gameplay distance; coherent wear, moisture and wet-surface response are insufficient.

Terrace approach is dominated by even cool sky illumination and dark support shadows, with insufficient motivated warm practical light or atmospheric depth. The hall does show warm light; that does not qualify the exterior.
Service-bay red growth is visible, but the terrace route and broad adjacent framing lack coherent infection invading the engineered structure.
Bright blue mannequin-like player presentation remains plainly visible. Preserved movement/animation mechanics are not final focal-art acceptance.

limits: Instrument-assisted navigation does not establish external-player usability.
This task does not claim D17-04 full encounter or D17-08 whole-slice qualification.
Functional camera/collision success cannot close the listed major defects.

next_creation_boundary.action: Re-author approach/terrace route framing with grounded industrial junctions, motivated practical route cues and physically coherent surface breakup; integrate retained red growth while preserving walkable planes and camera clearance. Qualify the affected cooked content through the same raw route before acceptance.
next_creation_boundary.preservation: Preserve existing traversal/collision bounds and accepted combat, AI, objectives, streaming and predecessor evidence; no owner-review pause.
